name: takatime
description: A privacy-first, serverless time tracker. Track coding metrics, visualize productivity, and maintain full data ownership.

commands.title: TakaTime: Open Legacy Go Dashboard (deprecated — sums the retired duration field)

enumDescriptions: Session state and length, then today's total.
takatime.stats.statusBar.description: What the TakaTime status bar item shows. The icon always indicates whether a session is active.

takatime.stats.weekDays.description: Length in days of the trailing window used for 'this week' totals and leaderboards.

takatime.stats.refreshSeconds.description: How often the status bar re-reads the stats. Heartbeats are throttled to 120s, so polling faster than that mostly re-renders the same number.

takatime.stats.autoStartServer.description: Start the local stats server (analytics/server.mjs) if nothing is listening. It exits on its own after 30 minutes with no requests.

takatime.stats.port.description: Loopback port for the stats server. Must match --port if you run the server yourself.

takatime.stats.analyticsPath.description: Directory holding the analytics bundle. Defaults to ~/.takatime/analytics, where scripts/build-binaries.sh installs it.
